paragraphs: To get a permit to run a cannabis store, you must give the Office of Cannabis details of your business.
We will ask you for the following information on the storefront retail operations form of the cannabis business application.

sections.heading: Monitoring traffic
paragraphs: We will ask how your staff will handle traffic and parking. Include how you will handle activity during peak hours.

sections.heading: Supplying medical cannabis
paragraphs: You must have a space where medical cannabis patients can speak with staff confidentially. We will ask:
How you will support medical cannabis patients
How you will make sure you always have medical cannabis in stock, such as tracking inventory

sections.heading: Building a consumption lounge
paragraphs: We will ask if you want to build a space where customers can consume cannabis they bought in your store.
Get a consultation for your cannabis consumption lounge plans.
